text.description_html:
Stainless Steel Overhead Concealed Door Stop, ROC-OH202M

The standard duty, stainless steel OH200 Series Concealed Overhead Stop & Holder is a versatile option designed for use with both single and double-acting medium-weight doors experiencing medium traffic. Featuring a heavy shock absorber spring that offers 5-7 degrees of compression before reaching the deadstop, this stop and holder system is suitable for various applications. Moreover, its stop function is UL listed for use in fire door assemblies, providing an added layer of safety and reliability.

For interior single or double acting doors. Non-handed.

Features of the Rockwood OH202M Overhead Concealed Door Stop:

  • Doors may be single or double acting
  • Slide track design
  • Recommended for medium traffic, medium weight doors
  • Degree of opening is fully adjustable and can be adapted to changing needs
  • Heavy shock absorber spring provides 5-7° compression before deadstop
  • Durable slider cam and shock block
  • Stop function UL listed for fire door assemblies
  • 110° maximum opening
  • 3/4" square channel

Specifications of the Rockwood OH202M Overhead Concealed Door Stop:

  • Base Material: Stainless Steel
  • Fastener: Jamb: #12-24 x 1/2" FH MS or #12 x 1-1/2" FH WS Door: #12-24 x 1-1/2" FH MS or #12 x 1-1/2" FH WS
  • Complete screw packet kit for installation in wood or metal door and frame

Sold individually
